decisions.reason: Adding future locations without redesign concerns template extensibility and does not change the master site's existing national role, booking handling, or positioning.
The decision does not add a future location or alter the existing requirement for dedicated pages and consistent cross-location design.
Template extensibility does not change the selector's current options or routing destination; no future location is being added by this decision.
The reusable-template decision does not change the separate Wix-site and account architecture used by operational locations.
Avoiding redesign for future locations does not modify the visual references, style, navigation, or design-consistency attributes.
The decision concerns reusable location-site structure and does not change Wix booking, booking hosting, or master-site booking behavior.
Future location extensibility does not add, remove, or otherwise change any master-homepage section or offering-visibility rule.
The no-redesign decision does not alter the requirement that the site be mobile-friendly.
Template reuse for future locations does not change the brand name, colors, consistency, or national positioning.
The source decision does not change isolation of bookings, revenue, sales, calendars, accounts, or reporting between locations.
The decision does not modify the existing package catalog or pricing policy for reused location-site formats.
Future location template extensibility does not alter separate payout handling or the payment-isolation mechanism.
